name: The Enchanted Glade
summary: Bloodfeather harpies threaten the Oracle Glade on northwestern Teldrassil, where Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak guards the ancient Oracle Tree. After harpies kill a runner bound for Darnassus, Arynia calls for their nests to be thinned and their belts brought back as proof.

sections.title: A Glade Under Siege
sections.body: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak watches over the Oracle Glade with an escort of warriors. The sacred retreat centers on the colossal Oracle Tree, an ancient rooted among Teldrassil's boughs. Bloodfeather harpies have spread through the surrounding canopy, nesting in the hollows and threatening anyone who comes near.

sections.title: Severed Lines to Darnassus
sections.body: A runner carrying an urgent report from the Oracle Tree never reaches Darnassus. Bloodfeather harpies ambush and kill the messenger before the runner can leave the glade. Arynia calls on you to thin their flock and bring back Bloodfeather belts as proof that their nests have been weakened.

sections.title: A Summons from the Tree
sections.body: The Oracle Tree sends a piece of its enchanted bark as its nearby nests are thinned. The ancient seeks an emissary to carry its message to the high leadership of the kaldorei.

faq.q: Why are harpies attacking the Oracle Glade?
faq.answer: The Bloodfeather clan nests across northern Teldrassil, and its harpies have surrounded the Oracle Tree. They guard their roosts fiercely and attack anyone traveling to or from the sacred glade.
Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak is an officer stationed with a modest vanguard in the Oracle Glade. She guards the Oracle Tree from nearby harpies and works to restore contact with Darnassus.

faq.q: What happened to the runner sent to Darnassus?
faq.answer: Bloodfeather harpies ambushed and killed the runner carrying a report from the Oracle Tree to Darnassus along the glade paths, before the messenger reached safety.
The Oracle Tree is a massive, sentient ancient rooted in the Oracle Glade. It watches over the boughs of the World Tree and sends wisdom and warnings to the night elf leadership.

faq.q: What proof does Sentinel Cloudsbreak require?
faq.answer: Sentinel Cloudsbreak asks you to bring back six Bloodfeather belts from slain harpies as proof that their roosts around the glade have been thinned.

faq.q: What happens after culling the harpies?
aliases: what does oracle tree do next
faq.answer: After the nearby harpies are thinned, the Oracle Tree sheds a piece of its bark. You can carry the ancient's long-delayed message toward Darnassus.

angles.text: As a night elf, defending the World Tree's ancient spirits and protecting the Sentinels from harpy attacks is a solemn duty.
As an Alliance member, helping the Sentinels secure Teldrassil's sacred groves strengthens ties with the night elf leadership in nearby Darnassus.
As a druid, you hold sentient ancients in great reverence. Clearing harpies that threaten the Oracle Tree helps protect the glade's natural balance.
